# **About Us – A Legacy of Craftsmanship**
GE Patterns & Foundry was built on hard work, dedication, and expertise in the foundry industry. Founded over 30 years ago by Mr. GE Robins, our business has grown from a small garage operation to a fully equipped foundry producing high-quality castings. Today, under the leadership of CL Robins, we continue our tradition of excellence, providing top-tier castings and patterns for various industries.
![](https://gepatterns.co.za/Cache/cached_1280x0_home-1.jpg)
![](https://gepatterns.co.za/Cache/cached_1280x0_home-1.png)
## **Our Capabilities – Precision and Quality**
We have the capacity to produce up to 60 tons of castings per month, with advanced induction furnaces capable of handling castings from 1kg to 800kg. Our expertise includes working with a variety of materials, including cast iron, SG iron, manganese steel, chrome steel, and stainless steel. Every casting is produced to meet industry standards, ensuring durability, precision, and reliability.
### **Why Choose Us – Experience, Innovation, and Trust**
At GE Patterns & Foundry, we believe in quality, trust, and customer satisfaction. Our team is committed to delivering superior castings on time and to specification. With decades of experience, a skilled workforce, and a customer-first approach, we provide reliable solutions for clients across South Africa, Africa, and Europe. Contact us today for all your casting needs!

# **Leading Manufacturing Steel Company – GE Patterns & Foundry**
## **Who We Are**
GE Patterns & Foundry is a premier manufacturing steel company based in Brakpan, Gauteng, with over 30 years of industry excellence. Founded by G.E. Robins and now under the leadership of C.L. Robins, our family-run foundry has grown from a modest garage workshop into a fully equipped facility producing high-quality castings for clients across South Africa, Africa, and Europe. 
## **Our Manufacturing Capabilities**
At GE Patterns & Foundry, we specialize in producing a wide range of steel and iron castings, making us one of the most trusted manufacturing steel companies in the region. Our advanced induction furnaces enable us to cast components weighing from 1kg to 800kg, delivering up to 60 tons of ferrous castings every month. 
We work with diverse materials including:
  * Cast iron and SG (spheroidal graphite) iron
  * Manganese and chrome steel
  * Stainless steel 


From pattern-making to final finishing, our full-service foundry delivers precision, reliability, and conformity to client specifications.
### **End-to-End Services for Steel Manufacturing**
We offer a complete suite of foundry services, including:
  1. **Pattern Making** – Our pattern shop uses advanced techniques and CAD/CAM tools to ensure accurate designs. 
  2. **Moulding & Casting** – Using green-sand and nobake molding, we cast in ferrous and nonferrous metals. 
  3. **Heat Treatment** – In-house thermal treatments such as normalizing, tempering, quenching to enhance material properties. 
  4. **Quality Assurance** – Spectrographic testing, hardness checks, and non-destructive testing for complete confidence in material integrity. 
  5. **Finishing** – Shot-blasting, grinding, machining, welding, and painting – our finishing processes guarantee durability and dimensional accuracy. 


## **Why Choose Us Among Manufacturing Steel Companies**
  * **Proven Expertise:** Over three decades of craftsmanship and technical know-how in steel casting. 
  * **Sustainable Operations:** We have invested in a 250kW solar system, achieving 49% grid independence — reducing our energy costs while lessening our environmental footprint. 
  * **Flexible Production:** With the capacity to cast from 1kg up to 800kg, we cater to small-scale and high-volume industrial projects. 
  * **Global Reach, Local Roots:** Serving industries in mining, engineering, agriculture, and power generation across South Africa, wider Africa, and Europe. 
  * **Commitment to Quality:** Rigorous testing protocols ensure each casting meets stringent performance and durability standards. 


## **Industries We Serve**
GE Patterns & Foundry is a trusted partner for sectors including:
  * Mining — supplying wear-resistant and abrasionresistant castings
  * General Engineering — precision parts, impellers, gears, and more
  * Pump & Valve Manufacturing — customized casings, bodies, and internals
  * Power Generation & Construction — cast steel components built to last


## **Contact GE Patterns & Foundry**
If you’re looking for a reliable steel manufacturing company, GE Patterns & Foundry is your partner of choice. Contact us today to discuss your casting needs, request a quote, or schedule a consultation. Visit our website at **gepatterns.co.za** or call **0716961177**.

# Manganese Steel Casting
High manganese, austenitic (non-magnetic), work hardening steel. It has very high strength, ductility, toughness and excellent wear resistance in the most punishing applications. In addition, this steel has a very low coefficient of friction which is very important to wear resistance – especially in steel to steel applications. This steel thrives on severe wear conditions. The more impact and hammering it receives, the harder the surface of the steel becomes. This characteristic is known work-hardening. The fact that the material remains ductile underneath, makes it a most effective steel in combating impact and abrasion. 
Our Wide Range of Manganese Steel Castings is tested over various parameters, thus assuring optimum porosity & grain structure. These Manganese Castings are customized as per the specifications of our clients and are demanded in various industries by keeping into consideration the International Standards.
Manganese is grey-white metal with a pinkish tinge, and a very brittle but hard metallic element. Manganese is a reactive element that easily combines with irons in water and air. It is a steel with a relatively large component about 10 -14% of manganese; highly resistant to wear and shock.
The original austenitic manganese steel, containing about 1.2% C and 12% Mn
## Applications:
Manganese steel is used in equipment for handling and processing earthen materials (such as rock crushers, grinding mills, dredge buckets, power shovel buckets and teeth, and pumps for handling gravel and rocks). Other applications include fragmentize hammers and grates for automobile recycling and military applications such as tank track pads.
## Specifications:
**Grades** - We offer all grades of Stainless Steel Casting which offers better corrosion, wear and heat resisting.
**Manufacturing Capacity** - We can manufacture up to 700 kg's
